column1: # Allowlist for the banned-terms rules in ./tools/check docs.
# A finding is suppressed when the file matches the glob AND the offending line
# matches the regex. Regexes are Python `re`, applied case-insensitively.
# Every entry needs a reason: an allowlist without reasons becomes a silencer.
# The allowed hits named in docs/voice-and-naming.md section 4 are the first
# three entries; everything after them is a specific, argued exception.
